core_obligations: Define the classes: take the blowing up, Q and T from the graph construction, choose the open and closed piece T' of T where Q is zero or of rank < p, and use condition (2) of the situation to see that T' -> T -> W_infinity -> X are isomorphisms over X minus Z (proof lines 10719-10738).
Obtain P_p(Z -> X, E) = P'_p(Q) and c_p(Z -> X, E) = c'_p(Q) from Lemma labelled lemma-localized-chern-pre and verify the defining property using Q|_{X x {0}} = E (proof lines 10740-10748).

Verify that the Chern classes of Q are defined by handling the four alternatives of condition (3) of the situation: two by passing to the proper W, one by a locally bounded complex of finite locally free modules, and one by pullback from a suitable base X' (proof lines 10750-10784).
proof_roadmap: Recall the data produced by the graph construction (proof lines 10719-10731).
Choose T' and construct the classes from the localized Chern class lemma (proof lines 10733-10748).
Reduce the definition question to the four cases of condition (3) (proof lines 10750-10756).
Settle each case, the last by base change and pullback (proof lines 10758-10784).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that in Situation labelled situation-loc-chern there are canonical bivariant classes P_p(Z -> X, E) and c_p(Z -> X, E) in A^p(Z -> X) characterised by i_* o P_p(Z -> X, E) = P_p(E), resp. i_* o c_p(Z -> X, E) = c_p(E), as bivariant classes on X (statement lines 10700-10717). The proof constructs them from the blowing up b : W -> P^1_X and the perfect object Q in D(O_W) produced by More on Flatness, Section labelled flat-section-blowup-complexes-III and Lemma labelled flat-lemma-graph-construction: with T in W_infinity the given closed subscheme and T' the open and closed piece on which Q is zero or of rank < p, condition (2) of the situation makes T' -> T -> W_infinity -> X isomorphisms over X minus Z, so an application of Lemma labelled lemma-localized-chern-pre with the data W, b, Q, T' yields P'_p(Q) and c'_p(Q); using Q|_{X x {0}} = E by construction gives the classes and their defining property (proof lines 10719-10748). The second half is a separate verification that the Chern classes of Q are defined, and it is exactly where the four alternatives of condition (3) of the situation are consumed: in cases (3)(a) and (3)(b) one passes to W, which is proper over X, and applies Lemma labelled lemma-chern-classes-defined; in case (3)(c) the object Q is represented by a locally bounded complex of finite locally free modules by part (5) of the graph construction lemma; in case (3)(d) one compares with the analogous construction over a base X' with quasi-compact irreducible components using More on Flatness, Lemma labelled flat-lemma-complex-and-divisor-blowup-base-change (proof lines 10750-10784). The author marks that paragraph with 'we suggest the reader skip this' (proof line 10756), but the argument is written out. Disentangling the four cases of condition (3) so that Lemma labelled lemma-chern-classes-defined applies, and seeing that the definition of the classes does not depend on the chosen data, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
